items.title: UNITAR and Joshua Michael Collaborate on Tamil Deepavali Film ‘Sattham’
items.sum: UNITAR International University and content creator Joshua Michael have collaborated on 'Sattham', a 14-minute Tamil-language Deepavali short film centred on a classroom creativity challenge. Malaysian actor Ganesan Manohgaran plays the lead role alongside a supporting cast. The project blends comedy, satire, and emotional storytelling about family celebrations.
